dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped light-pigment rings featuring sharp edge gradients transitioning from low-reflectance exterior pixels to high-reflectance interior pixels, predominantly in the dorsal-central region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, scattered primarily along the ventral-lateral transition zone and posterior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the primary dorsal annuli form an irregular polygonal chain extending from the mid-dorsal to the posterior region.

other_distinctive_markers: Lateral view of the right foreflipper exhibiting five distinct, high-contrast, dark-toned ungual structures.
